_help: camera views shared by the Studio booth (kit vfx booth) and the browser player (kit vfx play). pos / look in effect space (x right, y up, -z forward), fov degrees. A view is a static frame or a `path` of keys lerped on the effect clock (smoothstep). Presets add their own in booth.viewDefs. combat = another player watching the fight from game-camera distance (~30 studs, fov 70): the pros judge an effect as players see it, not close up.
